verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a SaaS monitoring product like Raygun, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of selectable data regions or residency. The only nearby features are client-side filtering of sensitive data and a flag to disable IP address storage, which are adjacent privacy controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
